prompts.shampooPrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a square photorealistic ecommerce product photograph for fictional Birchbark Pet Studio. One 500 ml oatmeal dog shampoo bottle, pale cream body, forest green pump, understated cream label reading exactly "BIRCHBARK" then "Oatmeal Soothe" then "500 ml". Warm off-white studio backdrop, soft daylight, realistic shadow and materials. Product centered with ample margins, bottle wholly within central 65% height so landscape card crop preserves it. Premium but believable neighborhood pet studio retail photography. No extra objects, no medical claims, no watermarks.
prompts.shampooEditPrompt: Edit this product photograph only by zooming out / extending the same warm ivory studio backdrop. Keep the exact bottle design, pump, label text and lighting unchanged. Make the entire bottle, from pump to base, fit within the central 60% of image height with generous blank margin above and below, centered. Square image. This is for a 4:3 center-cropped catalog card and the full pump and base must remain visible after cropping. No additional objects or text.
prompts.travelPrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Square ecommerce photograph, matching a fictional Birchbark dog shampoo line: a single small 100 ml travel bottle with cream body and dark forest-green flip-top cap (not pump), cream paper label with dark green serif text exactly "BIRCHBARK", "Oatmeal Sootothe" is forbidden: correct wording is "Oatmeal Soothe", then "100 ml". Tiny tasteful dog botanical line illustration. Warm off-white studio surface and backdrop, soft daylight, realistic shadow. Bottle appears compact, central 55 percent of canvas height with generous empty space above and below for wide card cropping. No other objects, no watermarks, photorealistic.
prompts.brushPrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Square photorealistic ecommerce image of one real-looking self-cleaning pet slicker brush, dark forest green ergonomic handle and rounded rectangular brush head, densely spaced thin silver bent wire bristles, clearly visible cream push-button on back edge for retracting bristles. Three-quarter angled view lying diagonally on warm ivory studio surface, entire object in central 60% of frame, generous margins for landscape crop. Soft natural daylight, subtle contact shadow, fine realistic material detail. No text, logos, people or other objects. Consistent premium neighborhood pet studio catalog style.
prompts.giftPrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Square realistic studio photo of a forest-green gift card resting on a cream envelope on warm ivory tabletop, subtle natural shadow. Card landscape orientation centered with ample space for square or wide crop. Elegant understated cream serif typography reading exactly "BIRCHBARK" then "PET STUDIO" then "Gift card". Small tasteful botanical line motif. No value, no redemption code, no QR code, no extra text or watermark. Consistent pet studio retail catalog imagery, soft daylight, realistic textured paper.

googleProducts.tool: Google Gemini API, model gemini-3-pro-image, 1:1, with it_shampoo.jpg and it_brush.jpg as style references
googleProducts.style: Square photorealistic ecommerce product photograph for the fictional Birchbark Pet Studio retail line, matching the two reference photos exactly in style: warm ivory/off-white studio backdrop and surface, soft natural daylight from the left, gentle realistic contact shadow, premium but believable neighbourhood pet studio retail. Brand palette: cream and deep forest green (#2E4A3F) with a small tasteful line-drawn dog-and-leaf botanical motif where there is a label. Single product, centered, wholly within the central 60% of the image height with generous empty margin on all sides so a 4:3 centre crop keeps the whole product. No extra props, no hands, no people, no pets, no watermarks, no text other than what is specified. Any label text must be spelled exactly as given.
